result.summary: The page is largely well-structured and visually consistent. One notable issue: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon, unlike the other three tabs, creating an inconsistent and possibly broken-looking navigation bar. The partially visible carousel item on the right and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behaviors and not defects.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' each have an icon. This makes the navigation bar look visually broken/inconsistent and leaves an empty gap above the 'Orders' text.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon (e.g., a receipt or bag icon) above the 'Orders' label to match the other navigation items and maintain visual consistency.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red indicator dot but no visible badge count or text label, which may be unclear to users and screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider showing a numeric badge for clarity.
